newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African banks lift total assets 18.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: S.African banks lift total assets 18.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: The total assets of the South African banking sector increased by 18.5 percent to 471.3 billion rand at the end of 1996, after a similar increase of 18.0 percent in 1995, the Registrar of Banks said on Thursday.
The average capital adequacy ratio dipped slightly to 9.7 percent from 10.04 percent at end-1995, Christo Wiese said in the Annual Report of the Reserve Bank's Bank Supervision Division.
Average return on assets for the year, after tax, was steady at 0.9 percent while the average return on equity slipped to 12.6 percent from 12.9 percent.
